move.subject: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
move.body:
Thank you for your offer. We have moved on our side; please see our updated terms.

To support the price in our term sheet:
Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
Your on-time delivery averaged 74.9% over the last 4 quarters (sc:70240@2026Q3, sc:70240@2026Q2, sc:70240@2026Q1, sc:70240@2025Q4).
Could you confirm lead time days of at most 42?
Could you send us a breakdown of the costs behind your price?

move.text:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. We also checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. I can't send a cost breakdown since we don't share that internal stuff, but I did factor in your points on power costs and our delivery score. Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Our current offer is a price of €34.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. I can agree to the 60 days payment you proposed, but financing that means the price has to be €33.50. Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 42 days: a price of €33.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.
